stratagems.name: Manoeuvre and Fire
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit Falls Back.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Tip of the Talon
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of ranged attacks made by your unit that target an enemy within Half Range.

stratagems.name: Rapid Reactions
stratagems.description:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement phase, just after an enemy unit Falls Back from a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit.
TARGET: That friendly INFANTRY unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but must target only that enemy unit.
